text_blocks.snippet: Cryotherapy for skin, also known as cryosurgery, is a procedure that uses extreme cold to destroy or remove abnormal skin tissue. It's commonly used to treat skin lesions, such as warts, skin tags, sunspots, and certain types of precancerous lesions. Liquid nitrogen is typically used to freeze the targeted area, causing cellular damage and eventually leading to the removal of the treated tissue.
